hospitalization_proxy.meaning: Unadjusted ILINet/FluSurv training proxy, original log(rate+1) regression, rate rounded to 2 decimals, original population, count rounding, dates through 2019-06-30 shifted 728 days. Regime adjustment is applied at forecast time.

hospitalization_calibration.meaning: Unshifted proxy counts before ED fraction and count rounding, used only for original state-specific legacy-regime offsets. Frozen calibration predictor history; observed outcomes and ED fractions are refreshed.

ilinet_normalized.meaning: Original per-location bestNormalize(ILI+1) values from the April 25, 2026 study input. These are transformed inputs, not raw percentages.
